title: Audio Capture Interface
text: Simulate capture of sample from audio stream on hardware, 1 input, 2 outputs, {Input} sets Source of simulated audio data From; {Value} sets the audio data to be output int16, {Object name} sets the timeseries object, {Sample time} and {Show event port} sets the option to enable task event ports. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: data
ports.summary: Data frame from captured audio M -element vector | M -by- C matrix

params.name: Input
params.values: Source of simulated audio data From dialog (default) | From input port | From timeseries object

params.name: Value
params.values: Audio data to be output int16([1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8]) (default) | C N -length vector

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Sample time in seconds -1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Show event port
params.values: Option to enable task event ports off (default) | on
